name: decision-support
description: Watches your prompts and the session's own decision points and, when a second opinion would help, asks whether to use the built-in /advisor and with which model (or shows the command). Deterministic rules only: no model calls, no network, no prompt text kept; it never submits a prompt for you and never edits settings files.

enabled.title: Suggestions on
enabled.description: Show advisor suggestions. /decision-support on|off overrides this per machine.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask holds a qualifying prompt (or end-of-turn decision) and asks; auto-suggest only shows a toast with the /advisor command; off is silent. /decision-support mode <x> overrides this per machine.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: low suggests rarely, high suggests whenever there is a clear signal.

deepModel.title: Deep model
deepModel.description: Advisor model suggested for security, contract and commercial risk.

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Advisor model suggested for design choices, risky actions, long plans and being stuck.

quickModel.title: Quick model
quickModel.description: Advisor model suggested for a fast sanity check.

stuckThreshold.title: Stuck after N failed tool calls
stuckThreshold.description: Suggest an advisor after this many tool calls in a row fail. 0 turns the stuck check off.

cooldownPrompts.title: Prompts between suggestions
cooldownPrompts.description: Minimum number of prompts between two prompt-based suggestions.
